cases.acceptance_basis: Q09 UDP AUTH/PMTU batch qualified; Q09 overall IN_PROGRESS. Q09-F001 gates both bare carrier PMTU formats on authenticated, AuthOK-sent, non-revoked state. Q09-F002 reserves the specific half-open handshake before spawn through admission/AuthOK; reaper/eviction preserve active reservations, all-reserved cap drops new handshakes, Drop releases completion/cancellation/rejected-spawn ownership. UDP verification uses original handshake deadline, with already-running blocking Argon2 retaining its permit. Four new unit regressions; 2283 Linux units/60 ignored and full/minimal Clippy/rustfmt PASS. Actual old/new UDP+QUIC comparison16 checks reproduces baseline PMTU ACKs before AUTH and fixes silence.35 admission E2E checks with real tunnel packets PASS; no forced live reaper race claimed. Fresh18/327 matrix, aggregate leak and100 TCP+100 QUIC/33 soak PASS on exact SHA. Four native independent A/B/ABI/copies/provenance PASS, binaries byte-identical because server-only changes are excluded from native targets. Full .10/.11 snapshots and working service/binary preserved. No deployment, push or benchmark. Prior limits/physical rows unchanged. Remaining Q09: TCP deadlines/saturation, anti-amplification, parser/fuzz and malformed/replay/reorder/proof/password/capabilities contracts.
